mapper.sql: sys17_corp_account_id AS corp_account_id, sys17_corp_id AS corp_id, sys17_bank_cd AS bank_code, f_cdnm('BankCode', sys17_bank_cd, 0, f_sysdate()) AS bank_name, TO_DECRYPTS(sys17_account_no) AS account_no_dec, sys17_account_nm AS account_name, sys17_main_account_yn AS main_account_yn
mapper.select: SELECT FROM sys17_corp_account WHERE sys17_corp_id = #{corpId} ORDER BY sys17_main_account_yn, sys17_bank_cd, sys17_account_no
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys17_corp_account (sys17_corp_account_id, sys17_corp_id, sys17_bank_cd, sys17_account_no, sys17_account_nm, sys17_main_account_yn) VALUES (#{id}, #{corpId}, #{req.bankCode}, #{accountNoEnc}, #{req.accountName}, #{req.mainAccountYn})
